## Unstructured Data Processing

> **SSA offering — how to engage:** If you are interested in this SSA Offering, follow the ASQ process (go/gethelp): Product Help > Pilot/Production Advisory; then put the tag #ssa-offering #unstructured-data-processing in both the **Title** and **Description** fields.

**GOAL:** Accelerate the design, build, evaluate, and productionization of complex intelligent data processing workflows that turn unstructured and multi-modal data into governed assets on the Databricks Lakehouse — using AI Functions, FMAPI for batch and streaming inference.

### Overview
This offering provides a curated set of reference workflows, evaluation harnesses, and Lakeflow Jobs for tackling the hardest unstructured and multi-modal data processing problems on Databricks. It moves customers beyond toy demos to production-grade pipelines that handle real document complexity, redaction requirements, and multi-modal inputs at scale.

### What's Included
- **Unstructured document processing — parsing, classification & extraction with AI Functions**: advanced use cases on challenging, complex documents (long PDFs, mixed layouts, low-quality scans)
- **Unstructured document processing — embedded asset extraction**: insight extraction from embedded images, multi-page tables, and charts
- **Unstructured document processing — sensitive information redaction**: PII/PCI/PHI detection and redaction workflows
- **Multi-modal data processing**: audio transcription, speaker diarization, and downstream analysis
- **Lakeflow Jobs templates**: orchestration patterns for each workflow above (batch and streaming inference)
- **Real-time streaming Jobs templates**: orchestration patterns for each workflow above (real-time streaming inference)
- **Evaluation harness for AI Functions**: structured evals to measure accuracy, quality, and latency of AI Function-based pipelines using MLflow

### Key Benefits
- **Production-Ready Patterns**: prescriptive workflows that go beyond demoware to handle real customer document complexity
- **Multi-Modal Coverage**: documents, images, tables, charts, and audio in one cohesive offering
- **Built-in Evaluation**: AI Functions evaluation harness so customers can quantify quality before scaling
- **Native Databricks Stack**: AI Functions, FMAPI, Lakeflow Jobs, Unity Catalog — no glue code or external orchestration
- **Batch + Streaming**: same patterns work for backfill and real-time inference

### GTM Signals — When to Engage
- Customer has large unstructured document or multi-modal corpora and is evaluating Databricks vs. point solutions
- Document workflows blocked by complex layouts, embedded charts, multi-page tables, or low-quality scans
- Compliance-driven redaction requirements (PII, PCI, PHI) on unstructured data
- Audio/contact-center transcription + analytics use cases
- Customer asking: "How do I run AI Functions at scale?", "How do I evaluate AI Function quality?", "How do I extract content from embedded images and charts in PDFs?"

### Technical Readiness Criteria
- Unity Catalog enabled; access to Mosaic AI Model Serving and AI Functions
- Source unstructured data accessible (UC Volumes, cloud storage, or streaming source)
- Named technical owner for the data pipeline

### Engagement Process (4-Step Joint Execution Plan)

**Step 1 — Discovery & Use Case Scoping** (4hrs FTE / 0.5 wks)
- Prerequisite: Customer has identified candidate unstructured / multi-modal datasets and a target downstream use case
- 1 Hour Sync: Review offering scope, walk through available workflow patterns (document parsing/extraction, embedded asset extraction, redaction, audio transcription/diarization), confirm participants and access
- Next Steps: Select the workflow patterns to pilot; gather representative sample data, ground-truth labels (where available) or performance goals, and volume/SLA targets

**Step 2 — Workflow Design** (8hrs FTE / 1 wk)
- Prerequisite: Sample data accessible in UC Volumes / cloud storage; target use case documented
- 1–2 Hour Session: Map customer requirements to AI Functions / FMAPI / VLM / OCR building blocks; design end-to-end pipeline (parse → classify/extract → store) and pick batch vs. streaming pattern
- Next Steps: Specialist delivers a reference workflow notebook adapted to the customer's data and a draft Lakeflow Jobs orchestration plan

**Step 3 — Build & Evaluate** (8+ FTE / 1 wks)
- Prerequisite: Reference workflow notebook reviewed; ground-truth or labeled sample ready
- 2 Hour Session: Walk through the AI Functions evaluation harness; run evals against the customer's sample data, review accuracy / quality / latency / cost trade-offs, iterate on prompts and model choice
- Next Steps: Tuned workflow checked into customer repo; eval baseline documented for ongoing regression tracking via MLflow

**Step 4 — Productionize on Lakeflow Jobs** (8+ hrs FTE / 1 wk)
- Prerequisite: Evaluated workflow meeting quality bar and SLA; SA owns the LLM batch inference debugging process (go/batchinference/debug)
- 2 Hour Session: Stand up Lakeflow Jobs (batch and/or streaming), wire in monitoring, alerting, and cost controls;
- Next Steps: Customer owns the production pipeline; specialist provides a 30-day check-in template and scaling playbook for additional workflows

### Customer Requirements
- Representative sample of target documents / audio files
- Clearly defined job volume, frequency, and SLA targets
- Workspace admin / catalog admin to provision UC objects, Lakeflow Jobs, and serving endpoints
- Stakeholders for downstream consumption (analysts, app developers, governance)
